## GET /v1/homes/property - 1 credit (standard)

Returns one Homes.com home by its link: the Place with its coordinates, the full description and the photo gallery, and `place.ext.listing` with the price, status (for_sale on a sale listing), beds, the exact bath count, square feet, lot size, year built and the listing brokerage. Homes.com sends no price or tax history here, so `price_history` and `tax_history` are null. A link Homes.com cannot read answers a refunded error.

**Use when** Use it with a Homes.com home link when you need one home's exact facts, description and photos.
**Cost** cache 900 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `url` (required) - A Homes.com home link under /property/, for example https://www.homes.com/property/4508-duval-rd-austin-tx-unit-604/4wgt29y2rsx2g/. · e.g. `https://www.homes.com/property/4508-duval-rd-austin-tx-unit-604/4wgt29y2rsx2g/`

**Response** `Place` object at `data`, `{ place }` ([full schema](schemas/Place.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `place.id` | Place ID… |
| `place.name` | Business / hotel name |
| `place.url` | Website or canonical URL |
| `place.address` | Street address as the source prints it. |
| `place.category` | Primary category… |
| `place.description` | Description of the place. |

+4 more (types in the full schema): `place` {image_urls, latitude, longitude}; `place.ext` {listing}. Never filled: `place.phone`, `place.price_level`, `place.rating.max`, `place.rating.value`, `place.reviews_count`, `place.verified`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/homes/property" \
  --data-urlencode "url=https://www.homes.com/property/4508-duval-rd-austin-tx-unit-604/4wgt29y2rsx2g/" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## Withdrawn endpoints (do not call)

These stay registered but return `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` today and never bill. A permanent withdrawal is not coming back - use the alternative named in the platform's other endpoints rather than retrying.

- `GET /v1/homes/search` - temporarily withdrawn while its data source is re-established. Returns `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` and never bills; check the changelog before retrying.
